title: Release v1.36.5 (initial Ubuntu full upgrade)
summary: NOT SUBMITTED FOR v1.36.5. This release updates Ubuntu during first-time host setup but does not change consensus state or transaction execution. It therefore registers no chain upgrade handler and must not schedule a software-upgrade halt. scripts/test_upgrade.sh reads the plan name below, confirms that no matching handler exists, and requires --no-chain-upgrade so the complete deployment and test rehearsal still runs without proposing a halt.
